Game Overview

At its heart, Kaku Quest is a platformer game about guide Kaku the parrot through vibrant 2D worlds, collecting rice bowls while dodging colorful rival birds and perilous traps. Master tricky jumps and outmaneuver spikes and saws to reach your goal. Can you conquer all eight challenging levels and prove your flying prowess?

How to Play

Getting started in Kaku Quest doesn't take long to learn. Guide Kaku the parrot through vibrant 2D worlds, collecting rice bowls while dodging colorful rival birds and perilous traps. Master tricky jumps and outmaneuver spikes and saws to reach your goal. Can you conquer all eight challenging levels and prove your flying prowess?
